messages:
cam: Quick pass on a 'Plum Graphite' dark theme. Goal: softer perceived contrast for long sessions, make 12px monospace crisp, and keep charts readable in thumbnails. Quick tokens below.

cam: tokens:
- --pg-bg: #0e0f11
- --pg-panel: #141517
- --pg-card: #17191b
- --fg: #e8ecf0
- --muted: #a6adb3
- --accent: #6fb7ff
- --warm: #ffc49a

joan: I like the plum undertone. Axis/gridlines are the usual problem on small charts. Suggest `--axis: rgba(255,255,255,0.06)` and `--grid: rgba(255,255,255,0.03)`.

shreya: contrast: fg on bg ~7:1 good. Muted ~3.3:1 so reserve for tiny microcopy only. If we surface labels >12px, use #cfd5da instead.

nate: syntax proposal (low-sat): keywords `#8fd6ff`, strings `#ffdcb0`, funcs `#d4c0ff`, comments `#6f777d`. Avoid bright greens.

mike: chart series idea: tone-shifted blues and a warm accent for alerts. Example: `#6fb7ff`, `#84abd0`, `#aabed6`, alert `rgba(255,196,154,0.12)` for fills. Keep lines as single strokes for sparklines.

cam: small CSS I dropped into the prototype:```css
:root{--pg-bg:#0e0f11;--fg:#e8ecf0;--muted:#a6adb3;--axis:rgba(255,255,255,0.06)}
.legend .chip{background:rgba(0,0,0,0.22);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.04);padding:4px}
```

shreya: a11y nit: add a "Contrast: Default / High" toggle that swaps muted and raises grid alpha; also add a Storybook test asserting token roles: body>=4.5, label>=3.0.

nate: color-blind sim looks OK for deuteranopia but the mid series needs +5% lightness on tiny legends. I'll post sims in #design-preview.

design-bot: Preview build: https://preview.redwood.design/plum-graphite-5 (build 441).

cam: copy tweak: change "Latency" axis to "P95 latency (ms)" in compact view. Next steps: nate posts sims, mike wires contrast toggle prototype, shreya adds Storybook checks. Quick 15-min sync tomorrow. :calendar:

mike: will prototype toggle and test on 13\" laptop.

shreya: adding a11y checks to PR template as well.

(reacts: :thumbsup: from joan, :eyes: from nate)
